description.value: Mutated beasts recognize something in you that isn't quite prey and isn't quite predator. Radiation-mutated animals and beasts start one step better on the attitude scale toward you than they otherwise would, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Command an Animal against them.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 Command an Animal bonus against radiation-mutated creatures is real (target:trait:mutant is a genuine actor trait in this corpus, e.g. site/data/cards/actors/bestiary/bestiary.sump-crawler.json). The attitude-shift half of the card ('start one step better on the attitude scale') has no rule-element hook -- there is no key that adjusts a creature's starting attitude toward the actor.
